themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and welfare. This theme appears in Spain, Italy, and France, with Vox, Lega, and Rassemblement National leading the charge, often clashing with center-right allies over these demands in coalition negotiations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government proposes EU-wide 'national priority' migration hubs, clashing with Macron

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Advocates for French priority in public contracts and social housing, framing it as economic patriotism

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Supports 'Polish priority' in welfare and housing, though less prominently than in previous runs

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The public feud between Donald Trump and Italian PM Giorgia Meloni has intensified into a full-blown diplomatic crisis, with Italy canceling high-level visits and EU leaders expressing solidarity with Meloni. The dispute centers on Trump's claims about Meloni's behavior at the G7 summit and broader disagreements over NATO, Iran, and EU policy.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump escalates attacks on Meloni, calling her a 'fan' who 'begged' for a photo and criticizing Italy's stance on Iran

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni denies Trump's claims, calls them 'fabricated,' and faces bipartisan support; Italy cancels U.S. diplomatic visits

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella expresses solidarity with Meloni, framing the dispute as an attack on European sovereignty

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Supports Meloni and criticizes Spain's government for not backing Italy more strongly

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine diplomatic crisis over WWII legacy
themes.blurb: Poland has revoked Ukraine's President Zelenskyy's highest state honor, the Order of the White Eagle, over Ukraine's decision to name a military unit after the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA), a group linked to WWII-era massacres of Poles. This has sparked a diplomatic crisis, with Ukraine returning Polish honors in retaliation and EU leaders warning of broader consequences for Ukraine's EU accession talks.
